title: DreamLedger Truth Oracle
description: Public registry of agentic commerce events with explicit evidence status. External events are never presented as DreamLedger-verified ledger events unless independently proven by DreamLedger evidence.

verification_policy.external_primary_source_verified: A primary source reports the event. DreamLedger has not independently cryptographically verified the underlying payment.
verification_policy.dreamledger_verified: DreamLedger possesses a verified economic event and tamper-evident ledger artifact.
verification_policy.reported_unverified: A public report exists but primary evidence has not been established.
verification_policy.disputed: Evidence conflicts or the event cannot currently be verified.

events.description: Mastercard reported New Zealand's first fully authenticated agentic transaction, using a Westpac-issued debit card to purchase cinema tickets with cardholder consent.
Mastercard reported a separate authenticated agentic transaction booking accommodation in Queenstown, processed through IPSI and completed using Maincode's Matilda model.
